description: Trafikkdata is the Norwegian Public Roads Administration's service for traffic counts from its registration points on state and county roads and some municipal roads. For motor vehicles the counting equipment records the speed, length, vehicle class and headway of each vehicle per lane; for cycles it records speed and direction. The data are shown in maps and tables on trafikkdata.no, with speed data exports, and are available through the Trafikkdata API in JSON. The current system has run since November 2014 for motor vehicles and July 2015 for cycles. Coverage is national. Access: free through the web application and the API under the Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD). Caveats: only some municipal roads are covered, and new registration points are still being added, so series lengths differ between stations. It supports traffic demand and flow modelling, calibration of network models, disruption impact studies and cycling analyses, and complements the NVDB road database catalogued here.
